opinions.text: C. A. 6th Cir. Motion for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Certiorari granted limited to Question 1 presented by the petition which reads as follows: “Whether Title 18 U. S. C. Section 922 (h) applies to petitioner who purchased a firearm in an intrastate transaction, and was not involved in any manner with the interstate transportation of said firearm.”
